nominee.longerDescription: Happy Woman Crush Wednesday! I may not listen to her songs, but ever since I watched a short interview with her, I'm keeping an eye on her, since she made the impression of someone really likeable! My favorite fun fact about her is that she's a fan of Puzsér (something they have in common with Kiara Lord). She aslo has funny shorts, one of them was recommended to me this morning, which is the reason I chose her for today.
